premise: Pelican scoops up a bottle instead of a snack; its cork pops, and the note inside is a drawing of a big white bird with a big orange beak: a pelican.
inspiration: The fisherman-finds-a-message folk motif turned comic and kind: the message from far away is a picture of the finder.
lesson: Someone, somewhere, may be thinking of you.

en-US.title: The Bottle and the Pelican
en-US.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to shore} Pelican was standing at the water's edge, looking for a snack. {pelican:face happy} {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gull watched, perched up high. [curious] What will he catch? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to pelican} Something green came bobbing in. {pelican:live scoop} Scoop! went Pelican's big pouch. {seagull:face surprised} Out drained the water… and there in his beak was a bottle! [laughs] {seagull:live squawk} Gull squawked with laughter. That's not a fish! {pelican:face surprised} Pelican tipped it this way and that. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} POP! went the cork, and out peeked a rolled-up note. {pelican:pulse} Pelican opened it with his beak. It was a drawing… of a big white bird, with a big orange beak. [gasps] It's ME! said Pelican. {pelican:face happy} {pelican:sparkle} Somebody far away drew a pelican! {seagull:live talk} [playfully] Then you're famous! said Gull. And Pelican {pelican:live flap hold} stood up tall, proud as can be. {pelican:hearts}

es-ES.title: La botella y el pelícano
es-ES.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to shore} Pelícano estaba en la orilla, buscando algo de comer. {pelican:face happy} {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gaviota lo miraba desde arriba. [curious] ¿Qué pescará? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to pelican} Algo verde llegó flotando. {pelican:live scoop} ¡Zas!, hizo el gran buche de Pelícano. {seagull:face surprised} Se escurrió el agua… ¡y en su pico había una botella! [laughs] {seagull:live squawk} Gaviota graznó de la risa. ¡Eso no es un pez! {pelican:face surprised} Pelícano la giró de un lado a otro. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} ¡POP!, hizo el corcho, y asomó una nota enrollada. {pelican:pulse} Pelícano la abrió con el pico. Era un dibujo… de un pájaro grande y blanco, con un gran pico naranja. [gasps] ¡Soy YO!, dijo Pelícano. {pelican:face happy} {pelican:sparkle} ¡Alguien muy lejos ha dibujado un pelícano! {seagull:live talk} [playfully] ¡Entonces eres famoso!, dijo Gaviota. Y Pelícano {pelican:live flap hold} se puso muy derecho, orgullosísimo. {pelican:hearts}

ja-JP.title: びんと ペリカンくん
ja-JP.text: {pelican:enter}{pelican:go to shore}ペリカンくんが、波打ち際で、おやつをさがしていました。{pelican:face happy}{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to rocks}カモメさんは、高いところから、じっと見ています。[curious]なにが、とれるかな？{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to pelican}みどりいろのものが、ぷかぷか、ながれてきました。{pelican:live scoop}ペリカンくんの大きなふくろが、がばっ！{seagull:face surprised}水が、ざーっとこぼれると…くちばしのなかには、びんが！[laughs]{seagull:live squawk}カモメさんは、「クワッ、クワッ！」 と大わらい。おさかなじゃないよ！{pelican:face surprised}ペリカンくんは、びんを、あっちにくるり、こっちにくるり。{bottle:live pop}{sfx:pop}スポンッ！コルクがぬけて、まるめたてがみが、ひょっこり。{pelican:pulse}くちばしでひらいてみると…絵です。オレンジいろの大きなくちばしの、大きな白いとり。[gasps]「ぼくだ！」 とペリカンくん。{pelican:face happy}{pelican:sparkle}とおくのだれかが、ペリカンをかいてくれたんだ！{seagull:live talk}[playfully]「じゃあ、きみ、ゆうめいじんだね！」 とカモメさん。ペリカンくんは、{pelican:live flap hold}むねをはって、えっへん！{pelican:hearts}

de-DE.title: Der Pelikan und die Flaschenpost
de-DE.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to shore} Der Pelikan stand am Ufer und hielt Ausschau nach einem Happen. {pelican:face happy} {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Die Möwe saß hoch oben und schaute zu. [curious] Was er wohl fängt? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to pelican} Etwas Grünes kam angeschaukelt. {pelican:live scoop} Schwupp! machte der große Beutel des Pelikans. {seagull:face surprised} Das Wasser lief heraus… und da steckte eine Flasche in seinem Schnabel! [laughs] {seagull:live squawk} Die Möwe kreischte vor Lachen. „Das ist doch kein Fisch!“ {pelican:face surprised} Der Pelikan drehte die Flasche hin und her. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} PLOPP! machte der Korken, und heraus lugte ein zusammengerollter Zettel. {pelican:pulse} Der Pelikan wickelte ihn mit dem Schnabel auf. Es war ein Bild… von einem großen weißen Vogel mit einem großen orangen Schnabel. [gasps] „Das bin ja ICH!“, sagte der Pelikan. {pelican:face happy} {pelican:sparkle} „Jemand ganz weit weg hat einen Pelikan gemalt!“ {seagull:live talk} [playfully] „Dann bist du ja berühmt!“, sagte die Möwe. Und der Pelikan {pelican:live flap hold} reckte sich ganz groß in die Höhe, stolz wie Oskar. {pelican:hearts}

fr-FR.title: La bouteille et le pélican
fr-FR.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to shore} Pélican attendait au bord de l’eau, à la recherche d’un petit en-cas. {pelican:face happy} {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Mouette le regardait, perchée tout là-haut. [curious] Qu’est-ce qu’il allait bien pêcher ? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to pelican} Quelque chose de vert est arrivé en flottant. {pelican:live scoop} Gloups ! a fait la grande poche de Pélican. {seagull:face surprised} L’eau s’est écoulée… et dans son bec, il y avait une bouteille ! [laughs] {seagull:live squawk} Mouette a crié en riant aux éclats. « Ça, ce n’est pas un poisson ! » {pelican:face surprised} Pélican l’a tournée dans tous les sens. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} POP ! a fait le bouchon, et un petit papier roulé est sorti. {pelican:pulse} Pélican l’a déroulé avec son bec. C’était un dessin… un grand oiseau blanc, avec un grand bec orange. [gasps] « C’est MOI ! » a dit Pélican. {pelican:face happy} {pelican:sparkle} « Quelqu’un, très loin, a dessiné un pélican ! » {seagull:live talk} [playfully] « Alors tu es célèbre ! » a dit Mouette. Et Pélican {pelican:live flap hold} s’est redressé, fier comme tout. {pelican:hearts}

it-IT.title: La bottiglia e il pellicano
it-IT.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to shore} Pellicano se ne stava sulla riva, in cerca di uno spuntino. {pelican:face happy} {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gabbiano stava a guardare, appollaiato lassù in alto. [curious] Che cosa pescherà? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to pelican} Qualcosa di verde è arrivato dondolando. {pelican:live scoop} Zac! Pellicano l'ha raccolto con la sua grande sacca. {seagull:face surprised} L'acqua è scolata via… e nel becco c'era una bottiglia! [laughs] {seagull:live squawk} Gabbiano ha strillato dal ridere. Altro che pesce! {pelican:face surprised} Pellicano l'ha girata di qua e di là. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} POP! ha fatto il tappo, ed è spuntato un foglietto arrotolato. {pelican:pulse} Pellicano l'ha aperto col becco. Era un disegno… di un grande uccello bianco, con un grande becco arancione. [gasps] «Sono IO!», ha detto Pellicano. {pelican:face happy} {pelican:sparkle} «Qualcuno, lontano lontano, ha disegnato un pellicano!» {seagull:live talk} [playfully] «Allora sei famoso!», ha detto Gabbiano. E Pellicano {pelican:live flap hold} si è messo tutto impettito, orgoglioso come non mai. {pelican:hearts}

zh-TW.title: 鵜鶘和綠瓶子
zh-TW.text: {pelican:enter}{pelican:go to shore}鵜鶘站在岸邊，想找點東西吃。{pelican:face happy}{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to rocks}海鷗停在高高的地方，在一旁看著。[curious]牠會撈到什麼呢？{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to pelican}有個綠綠的東西，一搖一晃地漂過來了。{pelican:live scoop}嘩啦！鵜鶘的大嘴袋一撈。{seagull:face surprised}水流光了……鵜鶘嘴裡，竟然是一個瓶子！[laughs]{seagull:live squawk}海鷗笑得大叫：「那又不是魚！」 {pelican:face surprised}鵜鶘把瓶子轉過來、轉過去。{bottle:live pop}{sfx:pop}啵！軟木塞跳開了，裡面露出一張捲起來的紙條。{pelican:pulse}鵜鶘用嘴巴把紙條打開。是一張圖畫……畫著一隻白白的大鳥，有個橘色的大嘴巴。[gasps]「是我耶！」 鵜鶘說。{pelican:face happy}{pelican:sparkle}好遠好遠的地方，有人畫了一隻鵜鶘！{seagull:live talk}[playfully]「那你出名囉！」 海鷗說。鵜鶘{pelican:live flap hold}挺起胸膛，站得直直的，好神氣喔。{pelican:hearts}

zh-HK.title: 瓶中信和鵜鶘
zh-HK.text: {pelican:enter}{pelican:go to shore}鵜鶘站在岸邊，想找點東西吃。{pelican:face happy}{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to rocks}海鷗停在高高的地方，看着牠。[curious]牠會捉到甚麼呢？{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to pelican}有一樣綠色的東西，一浮一浮地漂了過來。{pelican:live scoop}嘩啦！鵜鶘的大嘴袋一兜。{seagull:face surprised}水慢慢流走了……牠嘴裏竟然是一個瓶子！[laughs]{seagull:live squawk}海鷗笑得呀呀叫。那不是魚呀！{pelican:face surprised}鵜鶘把瓶子左翻翻，右翻翻。{bottle:live pop}{sfx:pop}啵！瓶塞彈了出來，裏面有一張捲着的紙條。{pelican:pulse}鵜鶘用嘴把紙條打開。原來是一幅畫……畫着一隻白色的大鳥，有個橙色的大嘴巴。[gasps]「係我呀！」 鵜鶘說。{pelican:face happy}{pelican:sparkle}在很遠很遠的地方，有人畫了一隻鵜鶘！{seagull:live talk}[playfully]「噉你出名喇！」 海鷗說。鵜鶘{pelican:live flap hold}挺起胸膛，站得高高的，好不神氣。{pelican:hearts}
